question:
Choose the word that is opposite in meaning to the given word.

Craving
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Craving"** means a powerful desire for something. (लालसा)

 
 
• **Example:** She had a **craving** for chocolate that she couldn't ignore.
 
 
 
• **"Satisfaction" **refers to the fulfillment of one's wishes, expectations, or needs, or the pleasure derived from this. (संतोष)
 
 
• **Example:** He felt a deep sense of** satisfaction** after completing the project successfully.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the **opposite** of **'Craving' **is **'Satisfaction'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Palate** (स्वाद): The roof of the mouth, or a person's sense of taste.

 
 
• **Example:** The wine's rich flavor pleased her palate.
 
 
 
• **Alarm** (चेतावनी): A sudden fear or distressing suspense caused by an awareness of danger.
 
 
• **Example:** He woke up in alarm when he heard the loud noise.
 
 
 
• **Pining** (विषाद): Suffering a mental and physical decline, especially because of a broken heart.
 
 
• **Example:** She was pining for her hometown after moving to a new city.
